Run the mirtverse analysis agent server

Source: R/agent-server.R
mv_agent_server.Rd

mv_agent_server() starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets an AI assistant such as Claude run item response theory analyses on the data in one project folder. The assistant reads your data, fits and compares models, checks items, tests for differential item functioning, scores people, draws plots, explains the results and writes an HTML report, all with mirtverse. Every step is also written as R code, so save_script leaves a script that reproduces the analysis.

Usage

mv_agent_server(
  project = NULL,
  transport = c("stdio", "http"),
  allow_run = NULL,
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = 8766,
  token = NULL,
  timeout = 600
)

Arguments

project

path to the project folder that holds the data. By default the MIRTVERSE_PROJECT environment variable when it is set (the .mcp.json written by mv_agent_init() sets it), otherwise the working directory, which for the plugin is the folder Claude Code was opened in.

transport

"stdio" (the client starts the server) or "http" (a URL the client connects to).

allow_run

logical; allow the run_r tool, which runs R code the assistant writes. Defaults to TRUE for stdio and FALSE for HTTP.

host, port, token

where the HTTP server listens; see mv_mcp_server().

timeout

seconds a single run_r call may take.

Value

Called for its side effect; returns NULL when the client disconnects.

Details

Fitted models live in the R session of the server and are saved in the project's .mirtverse-mcp/models folder, so they survive a restart. Files the server writes (plots, scores, reports, scripts) go to the mirtverse-output folder of the project. Your data files are only read, never changed.

You normally do not call mv_agent_server() yourself. The mirtverse plugin for Claude Code starts it in the folder you work in; for other clients, mv_mcp_config() with mode = "analysis" prints the settings, and mv_agent_init() sets up a folder for Claude Code without the plugin.

See also

mv_agent_init(), mv_mcp_config(), and the "mirtverse agent for Claude" article on the website.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# The plugin runs a script that calls mv_agent_server() in the folder
# Claude Code was opened in. By hand:
mv_agent_server("~/projects/math-test")
} # }
